name: St. Regis Aruba Resort
insider_take: This luxury beachfront sanctuary sits on pristine Surfside Beach, where flamingo-pink sunsets paint the sky and trade winds carry the scent of frangipani through elegantly appointed suites.
whats_special: The St. Regis Aruba is the island's only AAA Five Diamond resort, featuring the signature St. Regis Butler Service and exclusive access to one of Aruba's most secluded stretches of white sand beach. The resort's Remède Spa incorporates indigenous Aruban aloe vera treatments, while the Josephine Restaurant offers the island's most sophisticated culinary experience with locally-sourced Caribbean spiny lobster.
pro_tip: Book a Strand Suite for direct beach access and request your butler arrange a private sunset dinner on Surfside Beach – the resort's secluded location means you'll have front-row seats to Aruba's legendary sunsets without the crowds.
dont_miss: The weekly flamingo feeding at nearby Renaissance Island (accessible via the resort's concierge), snorkeling at the nearby Antilla shipwreck – one of the Caribbean's largest accessible wrecks, and exploring the colorful Dutch colonial architecture of downtown Oranjestad, just minutes away. The resort's signature Bloody Mary cart service on the beach is a must-try weekend tradition.
pros: Signature St. Regis Butler Service providing personalized luxury experiences
Prime beachfront location on Palm Beach with pristine white sand
Elegant accommodations with sophisticated Caribbean-inspired design
World-class spa and wellness facilities with tropical treatments
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit all vacation styles
